mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_product WHERE expiration_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND expiration_date < TRUNC(SYSDATE) +3
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_product SET discount_rate = CASE WHEN expiration_date <= SYSDATE + 3 THEN 50 WHEN expiration_date <= SYSDATE + 5 THEN 30 ELSE 0 END, discount_price = CASE WHEN expiration_date <= SYSDATE + 3 THEN product_price * 0.5 WHEN expiration_date <= SYSDATE + 5 THEN product_price * 0.7 ELSE product_price END WHERE expiration_date <= SYSDATE + 5
